**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I always struggle with shortcut X when switching from CorelDRAW / Photoshop..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what feature, keymapping, palette, or layout docker panel configuration you would like added.

**Target Application & Profile**
- [ ] Inkscape (CorelDRAW Profile)
- [ ] Inkscape (Illustrator Profile)
- [ ] GIMP (Photoshop / Corel PHOTO-PAINT Profile)
- [ ] Krita
- [ ] Other (Please specify)

**Proposed Shortcuts / Configuration**
If proposing specific hotkeys or docker layouts:
| Action | CorelDRAW / Source Hotkey | Proposed Afterburner Binding |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pick Tool | `Spacebar` | `Spacebar` |
| Shape / Node Tool | `F10` | `F10` |

**Additional context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.
